settings.title: Settings
settings.diagnostics.reference: Report {reference} was sent. Share this reference with Silo support.
settings.diagnostics.footer: Reports go to Silo Diagnostics with device and app details and recent logs, never your account, profile, server address, or library IDs, and are kept up to 30 days. siloserver.org/privacy
diagnostics.consent.title: Send Diagnostics?
diagnostics.consent.message: Silo sends a report to Silo Diagnostics, run by the Silo project, to help fix problems. It includes the app and Roku OS versions, device model, display and audio support, crash details, and this app’s logs from this launch and the one before. It leaves out your account, profile, server address, and library IDs. Reports are kept up to 30 days.
diagnostics.erase.title: Delete Sent Reports?
diagnostics.erase.message: Silo Diagnostics deletes the reports this Roku sent, and their reference IDs stop working.
diagnostics.crash.title: Silo Closed Unexpectedly
diagnostics.crash.message: Send a report to help fix it? It goes to Silo Diagnostics with the app and Roku OS versions, device model, crash details, and this app’s logs, never your account, profile, server address, or library IDs.
